title: Snake
description: Eat, grow, outlast. Solo or up to 8 players.

title: Brickstorm
description: Aim, launch, and break the storm. 25 heroes, skills, special bricks and a shop.

title: Caro
description: Five in a row. Play the computer, a friend on one device, or online. Draw on the board together.

title: Fuse
description: Slide and fuse tiles into huge numbers. Smash rocks, chain combos, race the computer or up to 4 friends.

title: Phantom Drift
description: Dodge down a neon rift. Read the danger, graze it for points, go Phantom and phase through.

title: Synthstride
description: Dance across a neon grid to the beat. Read the warned tiles, dodge on the drop, grab the notes. Solo or with up to 4 friends.
